title: Learning Feedback & Daily Summary
changes: Added a persistent Today summary on the dashboard that remains available after leaving lessons and games.
Today's summary shows new words, answers/accuracy, completed missions, activities played, and changes in Recognising, Recall and Usable vocabulary.
Added optional Keep Learning choices after the recommended three-step daily route is complete.
Added visible touch coaching so touch gestures are discoverable instead of hidden.
Added writing-system colour cues: Kanji uses a warm terracotta tone, Hiragana stays neutral, and Katakana uses a soft teal; colours adapt for light/dark text contexts.
Changed Kana correct/wrong feedback to a centred overlay so no scrolling is needed.
Kana feedback never auto-progresses; the learner must press Continue or View path summary.
Fixed Kotoba Rain getting stuck at 0 seconds by ending the run immediately when the timer reaches zero.
Logged Campfire Recall, Kotoba Rain and Kotoba Colosseum completions into the persistent daily summary.
Retains all v11.6 touch interactions, v11.5 Dashboard Clarity and v11.4 Adaptive Learning functionality.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.7.0.
